The U.S. has completed its military withdrawal from Iraq, leaving the country's security posture uncertain as regional tensions persist, with Secretary of State Rubio alleging a foreign actor's involvement in an airbase incident. A military airstrike on a market in Myanmar's Rakhine state has killed 50 people with dozens injured.
